name: Tebrau City Half Marathon 2026 Powered by JomRun® (aka BMW Millennium Welt Johor Half Marathon)
short_description: A half marathon event in Johor Bahru, Malaysia, held on 20 September 2026 with 21.1km, 10km, and 5km distance options.
ai_summary: The Tebrau City Half Marathon 2026 Powered by JomRun®, also known as the BMW Millennium Welt Johor Half Marathon, takes place on 20 September 2026 in Johor Bahru, Malaysia. Organized by Ultron, the race starts and centers around Toppen Shopping Centre and offers three distance options: 21.1km, 10km, and 5km. Registration is currently open for participants interested in joining this event in Johor.
pros: Multiple distance options (21.1km, 10km, 5km) suit a range of runner abilities
Centrally located at Toppen Shopping Centre in Johor Bahru for easy access
Registration is currently open, giving ample time to plan and sign up
research_highlights: The 2026 edition is part of the JomRun Half Marathon Series and offers 5KM, 10KM fun runs plus a 21.1KM competitive run with RFID timing for the half marathon distance.
The event is closely tied to the BMW Millennium Welt Johor Half Marathon/Run, which has historically been held in conjunction with the Tebrau City Half Marathon.
In the previous (2024) edition, race pack/bib collection was held at Decathlon @ Toppen Shopping Centre in Johor Bahru a few days before race day.
Only the 21.1KM finishers receive an additional Ultron® Finisher Jersey, on top of the standard event jersey and medal given to all distance finishers.

faqs.question: When is the Tebrau City Half Marathon 2026 taking place?
faqs.answer: The Tebrau City Half Marathon 2026 Powered by JomRun® is scheduled to take place on 20 September 2026. The event will be held in Johor Bahru, Johor, Malaysia, with Toppen Shopping Centre serving as the venue for this race weekend.

faqs.question: What distances can I run in this event?
faqs.answer: Participants in this event can choose from three distance options: 21.1km, which is the primary half marathon distance, 10km, and 5km. This range of distances allows runners of different experience levels and fitness goals to take part.

faqs.question: Who organizes the Tebrau City Half Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: This race, also known as the BMW Millennium Welt Johor Half Marathon, is organized by Ultron. The event takes place in Johor Bahru, Johor, Malaysia, and is centered at the Toppen Shopping Centre venue.

faqs.question: Is registration currently open for this race?
faqs.answer: Yes, registration for the Tebrau City Half Marathon 2026 Powered by JomRun® is currently open. Interested runners can sign up ahead of the race date on 20 September 2026 to secure their spot in the 21.1km, 10km, or 5km categories.
